acceptance: Decision gate (prior art): first check make/help.mk, scripts/ and _project/scripts/dev_loop_pr_metrics.py for an existing log reader to extend (make duplicate-check-delta); build new only if none fits.
Decision gate (untrusted input): log text is untrusted; the tool only prints it, bounded, and never executes or interprets it.
Verification: unit tests with recorded job and log fixtures cover a pytest failure, a lint aggregator failure that names the inner guard, an in-progress run, and a log with escape sequences.
Verification: output for one failed job is under 200 lines by default.
Done when merged, listed in make help, and referenced from docs/agent/merge-authority.md.
description:
Source: a retrospective over 25 agent sessions (2026-10-18 to 2026-11-11), followed by an adversarial re-check of each claim against origin/develop 4835f5a537.

Problem. There is no repository tool for reading CI failures. Three sessions pulled failed job logs by hand about 280 times (`gh run view --log-failed`, `gh api .../jobs/<id>/logs`), each with its own grep. Typical failures cost 3 to 5 calls; outputs reached 7 MB; `--log-failed` errors on escape sequences and on runs still in progress; lint aggregator jobs hide the real failing guard. `make pr-status` shows only check conclusions.

Owner decision 2026-11-11: track this, do not build it with the navigation fixes.

Proposed change. `make ci-failures PR=<n>` or `RUN=<id>`: list failed jobs (through the jobs API, so in-progress runs work), and for each print the failed step, `##[error]` lines, pytest `FAILED`/`ERROR` ids and a short tail, with escape sequences stripped and output bounded. Document it beside `pr-rerun` in docs/agent/merge-authority.md and in make/help.mk.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone, and pass absolute worktree paths to every file tool; stage paths explicitly, never git add -A; no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check); heavy work only via make heavy-run, never forcing admission or skipping the test lock; never bypass a required check, ruleset, hold label or review gate, and never post a stand-in; change only the files this item names, and report anything else as noticed-but-not-touched; re-read every cited file on current origin/develop before editing, because the line numbers here are hints from 2026-11-11 (origin/develop 4835f5a537); close at a merged PR (make pr-open, make pr-arm), and finish this item only after the merge is observed.
